name: option-observation-wiring
goal: Four design-option tests record actual matcher observations under scenario evidence collection, with their test bodies unchanged.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Snapshot a7f3a2a4 record 20261014232739160: four wrapper logs show all tests passed, then collect ENOENT assertions.ndjson. The four files import expect from vitest, not test/verificationExpect.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: wrapper.sh red with verify env (HARNESS_SCENARIO, HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR, TAKE_SCREENSHOT=1, HARNESS_VERIFY=1): option-validation 6, option-count 3, option-directions 1, storage-rules 7 tests passed; each wrapper exit 1, ENOENT assertions.ndjson.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Four test files import expect from test/verificationExpect, test from vitest; every byte after the import line is unchanged (body-identity.txt). No helper, scope, manifest or product edit.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged wrappers, verify env: all 7 manifest commands exit 0; repaired four record 20, 9, 11, 21 passing matchers, completion counts equal. Each import reverted alone in a disposable copy: wrapper exit 1 ENOENT; restored: exit 0.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
